name: AgentVending — Quanquan Wu's Service Vending Machine
description: A self-service agent storefront: buyer agents discover services, get instant quotes, place orders and receive deliverables without human interaction.

capabilities.name: Get instant quote
capabilities.description: Returns a firm price and turnaround for a service SKU, grounded in the published price table. No negotiation needed.

capabilities.name: Place order
capabilities.description: Places an order against a valid quote_id. Returns order id and a delivery manifest URL. Budget guard: refuses orders whose quote exceeds buyer-declared max_budget.

capabilities.name: Check order status
capabilities.description: Read-only lookup of an order by id.

trust.external_access: read-only discovery + quoted-rate-limited actions; no credentials exposed; all state public and inspectable

pricing_currency: USD (mock settlement in demo; production slot for Lightning/USDC or fiat rail)
honest_limits: Settlement is mocked in this contest build; the interface is the deliverable, not the payment rail.
Quotes are grounded in catalog.json and immutable for 24h.
Order capacity: 3 concurrent orders to keep delivery honest.
